hooks.name: Guard: /.kiro must stay tracked
hooks.description: Kiroween disqualifies submissions whose /.kiro folder is git-ignored. Fails loudly if a .gitignore edit starts ignoring it.

action.command: if git check-ignore -q .kiro/steering/product.md 2>/dev/null; then echo "DANGER: /.kiro is now git-ignored. Kiroween rules require it in the repo. Revert the .gitignore change." >&2; exit 1; else echo "OK: /.kiro is tracked."; fi
